answer: Each of 498 aliases needs its own mission records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A election observer accreditation with mission deployment record works as the gate: missions served as an observer across several elections. The copper is the bottleneck and the meadow is the receipt: a farm must clear both for each of its 498 aliases, the anchor trail is public, and one honest agent clears them once.
